title: Read the exact requested bytes of a static reactive HTTP resource
summary: The merged resource handler returned exactly So for bytes 0–1. A multipart response decoded with its advertised boundary returned So and t., matching the two separate range requests.

change.description: Four consecutive commits add a region encoder, a region writer, reactive static-resource handling and final refinements. The range begins before the encoder and ends after the final commit.

notes: The ten-byte upstream resource and the historical mock exchanges are read by Git revision and digest. The parent returned the complete representation to range requests.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-5.0.0.M2-q18. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.
